title: Kisra
description: Kisra is a Sudan classic prepared with sorghum flour, instant yeast, white sesame seeds. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Kisra-style sorghum flatbread with a yeast-assisted fermentation; regional naturally soured batter may differ.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cover the batter loosely and leave in a suitable warm, clean place for about 480 minutes to become bubbly and lightly tangy; do not refrigerate during active fermentation.
Spread a very thin layer of tangy sorghum batter onto a lightly oiled hot griddle and cook from one side until the top is set.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
